items.title: GTA VI: Why the 13-year wait could be worth $8 billion
items.summary: After more than 13 years, Grand Theft Auto VI finally launches on November 19, and it's about a lot more than a video game. Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian follows the money: why Take-Two is telling investors to expect $8 billion-plus in bookings this year but only about $109 million to $142 million in profit, how GTA Online's recurring spending became the real prize, and why Sony and Microsoft can cash in without making the game at all.

items.title: Why Tristan Thompson backed Anthropic early and is still bullish
items.summary: Former NBA player and early Anthropic investor Tristan Thompson sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to explain why he compares backing Anthropic to buying Google in the dot-com era. He also breaks down the secret behind his famous family's brand empire and why LeBron James will almost certainly own an NBA team.

items.title: Everpure Raises Revenue Outlook. AI Storage Boom Sets the Stage for More Growth.
